scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @cv/api build && pnpm --filter @cv/web build
scripts.format: prettier --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps packages scripts docs .github .claude AGENTS.md README.md "*.{json,yaml,js}"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps packages scripts docs .github .claude AGENTS.md README.md "*.{json,yaml,js}"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm lint && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test
